alt: A heart-shaped frame contains paper cutouts of the Microsoft Excel icon in green and the Microsoft Outlook icon in purple on a white polka-dotted surface.
caption: Green Excel and purple Outlook logos crafted from paper inside a heart-shaped frame.
description: Colorful paper crafts of Microsoft Excel and Outlook icons are placed inside a large heart shape. The Excel logo is made of teal squares with a white X, while the Outlook logo is purple with a white T and stylized circles. Rolls of pink, green, and brown paper sit nearby, suggesting a handmade or scrapbook style display.
